protocol.name: wayluck_wm_unstable_v1

description.summary: a window manager placing windows for wayluck

protocol.description:
The contract between wayluck and the window manager. The window manager owns placement: where each window goes, what's shown and what isn't. wayluck owns clients, buffers and pixels, and applies what it's told.
Unstable: changed in place, without version bumps, until it's frozen as wayluck_wm_v1. A window manager and a wayluck from different commits may not understand each other.

interface.name: wayluck_wm_manager_v1

description.summary: the window manager's connection to wayluck

interface.description: Bound by the one window manager. On binding, wayluck sends an output event for every output and a window event for every window, then ready. After that, it sends them as they appear.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Windows keep their places until another window manager binds.

request.name: transaction
request.description: Changes made through it are applied together on commit, or not at all.

event.name: unavailable
event.description: This manager does nothing; the client should destroy it.

event.name: window
event.description: A toplevel that wants to be shown. Until a transaction places it, it isn't.

description.summary: everything that existed at bind time has been sent
where it is, in global coordinates
the events before this one describe the output's current state
the output is gone; destroy it
ask the client to close it

event.name: closed

description.summary: the window is gone; destroy it

event.description: It's no longer shown, and placing it does nothing.

event.name: focus_request
event.description: wayluck doesn't focus it: the window manager decides, with a transaction's focus.

interface.name: wayluck_wm_transaction_v1
interface.description: Requests made before commit are collected, not applied. After commit, the transaction takes no more requests; wayluck answers with applied or failed, and then it should be destroyed.

description.summary: drop it; uncommitted changes are discarded

request.name: place

description.summary: show a window at a rectangle

request.description: Global coordinates. The client is asked to take that size; whatever size it commits, the window is shown at x, y.

description.summary: apply everything in this transaction, together

request.name: focus
request.description: With no window, no window has it. The focused window is drawn as active, and raised above the others.

event.name: failed
event.description: For example, a window in it was closed first.
